title: SDP: Don't replace generated Call-ID list
description:
It might be the case that the same SDP transport layer connnection
is used for multiple unrelated calls. Don't store the generated
Call-ID list at the SDP conversation level.

For SIP, when we have a file scoped transport_info_t that relates
requests and responses (note this doesn't work for provisional
183 Session Progress messages that often contain SDPs, see RFCs 3666
and 3312), store the list there. If we don't have a file scoped
transport_info_t (and thus the SDP packet is standalone, dissected
each pass, and not associated with a call transaction), store it
in packet info.

For the MEGACO and H.248 dissectors, the preferences to enable
context ID tracking may need to be enabled to add generated Call-IDs
to Requests that use the CHOOSE wildcard (in order to determine
the context ID from the Response.)

Note that there's still an issue, as previously, when a SDP contains
multiple media descriptions and another call ID shares RTP conversations
with some, but not all, of the media descriptions.

Fix #19753
